about: Hand-labelled claim/context pairs for the judge benchmark. ctx indexes contexts.json. label 1 = the context supports the claim, 0 = it does not. kind says how the claim was made: paraphrase/derived (supported); number, entity, negation, swap, unmentioned (not supported). Paraphrases avoid copying context wording so lexical overlap alone can't solve them.
